name: LiteLLM
description: Unified proxy server for 100+ LLM providers with OpenAI-compatible API, load balancing, and spend tracking.

env.label: Master API Key
env.description: Master API key for authenticating with the LiteLLM proxy

env.label: Database URL
env.description: PostgreSQL connection string for persistent storage (e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/dbname)

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.description: API key for OpenAI models — get from platform.openai.com

env.label: Anthropic API Key
env.description: API key for Anthropic Claude models — get from console.anthropic.com

env.label: Azure OpenAI API Key
env.description: API key for Azure OpenAI deployments

env.label: Azure API Base URL
env.description: Base URL for your Azure OpenAI resource (e.g. https://your-resource.openai.azure.com)

env.label: Gemini API Key
env.description: API key for Google Gemini (AI Studio) models; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Groq API Key
env.description: API key for Groq models; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Mistral API Key
env.description: API key for Mistral models; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Cohere API Key
env.description: API key for Cohere models; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: OpenRouter API Key
env.description: API key for OpenRouter models; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: DeepSeek API Key
env.description: API key for DeepSeek models; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: xAI (Grok) API Key
env.description: API key for xAI Grok models; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Store Models in Database
env.description: Persist models added through the admin UI to the database (requires Database URL)
